subject.title: fix(openrouter): apply request policy to music generation requests

question: Should OpenRouter music generation honor the existing sanitized models.providers.openrouter.request policy, including an explicit allowPrivateNetwork opt-in, instead of remaining unconditionally public-only?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically correct, but removing a path-specific private-network denial deliberately changes a network security boundary and repository policy routes that acceptance to the relevant owner.

options.title: Honor the existing policy
options.body: Accept the patch so OpenRouter music matches the documented provider request contract while remaining public-only unless the operator explicitly opts in.

options.title: Keep music public-only
options.body: Reject or narrow the PR and document music generation as an intentional exception that ignores private-network provider policy.

recommendation.title: Honor the existing policy
recommendation.body: Accept the patch so OpenRouter music matches the documented provider request contract while remaining public-only unless the operator explicitly opts in.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the shared guarded provider HTTP transport boundary that their prior work centralized.
